text:
Assistant A provides case studies (Microsoft in the US, Alibaba in China), which the user explicitly requested. It also gives a brief discussion of impact on competition and a conclusion. Its details are mostly accurate. The Alibaba fine was about 18.2 billion yuan (~$2.8 billion) in 2021, though the investigation began in December 2020, so this is roughly right. The Microsoft remedy description is roughly accurate.

Assistant B gives more detail on the statutes (FTC Act, dates, enforcement bodies) but includes no case studies, which was an explicit request. It also contains some inaccuracies, such as the claim that the FTC enforces antitrust in "consumer markets" while the DOJ does so in "business markets", and the same for SAMR and MOFCOM. Its comparison is also illogical, saying the AML "differs" from the Sherman Act because it prohibits mergers, which is a nonsensical contrast. It lacks discussion of impact on competition and ends abruptly.

Assistant A better fulfills the request.

[[A]]
